diagnosis: Customer reports sustained 429s over a ~20-minute window at ~5,400 rpm, consistent with hitting the plan ceiling. A rate limit increase above the plan ceiling requires a capacity review per kb-0004; they have submitted the peak and window needed.
reply: Thank you for the details. Sustained 429s across a whole window like yours typically indicate you are reaching the plan's rate limit ceiling rather than a burst issue. In the meantime, make sure your client honours the Retry-After header returned with each 429, adding jitter to avoid synchronized retries. Requests for an increase above the plan ceiling go through a capacity review; please include the peak sustained requests per minute and the window over which it was measured, which you've already provided. I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist.
